problems: These tools were left out during this turn; tell the user:
config:
Configures this chat page, which has no settings panel: its endpoints, model, system prompt, tools, display, style and every other setting. It runs lines of the KiSS CLI, one command per line; all lines of one call apply together or not at all, so batch related changes in a single call. Changes apply at once to the running configuration, and a call answers with what changed: the old line after -, the new one after +. The running configuration lasts until the page closes: copy running-config startup-config keeps it as what the page starts with, copy running-config <name> as a save, each once the user confirms it; copy <name> running-config goes back to a save, erase running-config back to the site defaults: offer to keep a change once it looks right.
Commands: set <module> <key> [name] <value> | no <module> <key> [name] | no <module> <name> | show <module> [key] [name] | show <module> <name> | show running-config [all] | show startup-config | show models | show css | show saves | show diff <config> <config> | copy <config> <config> | title <title> | show title | show conversations | export [<id>|all|<config>] | import | erase <id>|all|<config>. A config is running-config, startup-config or a save by its name. show running-config lists what differs from the defaults, show running-config all every key with its default. title renames this conversation when the user asks; the conversation keeps its title, so a title needs no save. show conversations lists the conversations by id; export offers the user a file of this conversation, of another by its id, of all, or of a config with its secrets, which reach the disk of the user and never you; import asks the user for a file and adds the conversations it holds that are not here yet, or runs the lines of a configuration as lines of the call; neither changes a conversation; erase removes a conversation by its id, all of them but the pinned ones, or a config, once the user confirms it; each of these runs alone on its line.
A key is two fixed words, a module then a key; a key of a collection such as endpoints takes the item name next; the value always comes last. no <module> <name> removes a whole item of a collection, when the name is none of its keys. A line that stops short lists what may follow it: set lists the modules, set display its keys. show models lists the models of every endpoint, by endpoint, with their settings; set chat model takes a name as it lists it. Each model has its own request parameters, sent only when set: set models <temperature|top_p|top_k|min_p|max_tokens|presence_penalty|frequency_penalty|seed|reasoning_effort> <model> <value>, reasoning_effort being what the template of the model reads. set tools rounds caps the tool rounds of a turn; set endpoints timeout <name> and set mcp timeout <name> give each server its seconds; set endpoints headers <name> 'Name: value; Name: value' and set mcp headers <name> send headers besides its key. set display thinking|tools closed, open or inference, open while the model writes them; set display render thinking|reply markdown or plain, plain in monospace as written. An MCP server, set mcp url <name> <url> and its bearer set mcp key <name>, gives you its tools; show tools lists every tool by who serves it; set tools use <name> off hides one, consent asks the user at each call, on lets it run. A change that opens a way out asks the user first, every time, whatever the command that makes it: the url of an endpoint or an MCP server, and opening a tool; a refused change stays refused, never reach it another way. The url of an item holding a key is the user's alone to change. To give a key, write the line without its value, set mcp key <name>: the user types it in a field of their own, so never ask them to paste a key in the chat. A secret reads <removed> in the lines kept: it is no value, never write it. set style <token> <value> sets a token of the page: show style lists them with their defaults, each a color, a length or a font; bg, fg and accent set a whole theme, every other color derived from them. show css lists the CSS of the page by component, a rule of a component carrying its class, svelte-composer for the composer, so a selector read there aims at that component alone; set style sheet <name> <css> restyles anything over it, the sheets applied by name, so one sheet holds one change. Words abbreviate while only one word starts so (sh run). Filter any output as IOS does, | include, exclude, begin or count <pattern>, the pattern the rest of the line, a regular expression minding case, count telling how many lines match: show running-config all | include ^set (tools|style). Quote values holding blanks.
Example call:
set style accent 'oklch(0.62 0.21 300)'
set endpoints url pod http://localhost:8080/v1
show style
